records.name: Greater Bustleton Civic League
records.summary: A neighborhood civic league for the Bustleton area. It holds a community meeting each month, posts local updates on its website, and takes membership applications.
records.what_you_do: Attend the monthly community meeting in person or on Zoom, or send in the membership application from the website.

schedule.text: Community meeting at 7 PM on the fourth Tuesday of each month

locations.label: Community Room, American Heritage Credit Union

first_step.how: Come to a monthly meeting in person or on Zoom, or send in the membership application on the website
first_step.basis: Meetings are posted each month with a Zoom option, and the site has a membership form

records.notes: The site lists the monthly meeting and posts news items with no dates, so status is probably_active (working site, no dates). Open to the public is inferred from meetings being posted with a Zoom link; the site also has a membership form, so a reviewer should check whether meetings are for members only. Mailing address on the City list is PO Box 51523, 19115. The personal contact email on the City list is left out. Humanitarian aid link lists on the site are not recorded.

records.name: Friends of Poquessing Watershed
records.summary: Volunteers who look after Poquessing Creek and the land around it. They run monthly cleanups, bird walks, tree planting, and storm drain marking.
records.what_you_do: Join a cleanup, a bird walk, or a planting day. Ask the group for the next date, since the website does not list dates.

schedule.text: Monthly cleanups. Dates are not posted on the website, so ask the group.

first_step.how: Email or call the group to ask about the next cleanup, or fill in the membership application on the website
first_step.basis: The site has a Get Involved section, a contact form, and a membership application

records.notes: The site has no dated events, so status is probably_active (working site, no dates). The park address 1217 Stevens Rd comes from the City Love Your Park directory, not the group's own site. No source read gives a neighborhood name, only ZIP 19116, so a reviewer should place it. The group says its watershed runs through Philadelphia, Bucks and Montgomery counties.

records.name: Pennypack Ecological Restoration Trust
records.summary: A land trust and nature preserve in Huntingdon Valley, Montgomery County, with volunteer restoration days. It is outside Philadelphia.
records.notes: Easy to confuse with the City's Pennypack Park groups. The site gives its address as 2955 Edge Hill Road, Huntingdon Valley, PA 19006, and does not mention the City of Philadelphia.

notes: Budget: all 6 WebSearch calls used (cap reached, no more searches). 17 WebFetch calls, plus one Read of the City RCO PDF (the fetch tool could not read its text, so the saved file was read directly). Verdicts: 2 publish, 1 out_of_area. The 20 to 40 target was not reachable. Most candidates in this slice appear only on the City Registered Community Organizations list (April 13, 2026), with no own website or no readable activity, so they went to leads_only, not records. Personal emails from that list were not published, and open-to-public was not stated for groups with no source. Refusals: northeasttimes.com refused every fetch (403), philadelphianeighborhoods.com refused two tag pages (403, retried once), libwww.freelibrary.org refused twice (403), easttorresdalecivic.com refused (403), and friendsofpennypackpark.org refused the connection. These look like bot blocks on specific domains, not one rate-limit wave, so I did not wait longer. Pennypack Environmental Center (8600 Verree Road, a Parks and Recreation facility, per search results) is a city building, not a group, so not recorded. Friends of Pennypack Park: a Northeast Times notice in search results says it went dormant in March 2020. No record until its site or that notice can be read. Byberry: no group with a readable page or City list entry was found in this slice. Academy Gardens: only the Northeast Community Civic Alliance on the City list. Out of this slice, seen on the City list with own websites, not fetched, for another lane: Rhawnhurst Civic Association (rhawnhurstcivicassociation.com), Fox Chase Civic Association (foxchasecivic.org), Friends of Ryerss at Burholme (ryerssmuseum.org), Mayfair Memorial Playground Friends (mayfairmemorialplayground.com). Poquessing Creek Park has no neighborhood name in any source read (ZIP 19116 only). Greater Bustleton Civic League is probably_active only because its site has no dates; its meeting time comes from the site.
